# Epic 3 Context: Multimodal Capture & Processing

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Users capture a journal Entry through one shared Insertion Modal in three ways — typed text, recorded audio, or a photo — and every modality ends up as the same persisted `Entry` shape. Audio is transcribed entirely on-device; a photo's text is recognized server-side via OCR before the Entry exists. Text and audio/photo stay merged into one epic because an un-transcribed audio Entry or un-OCR'd photo Entry is not a usable product outcome on its own — "capture" and "process" are one milestone here, not two. The epic also guarantees interrupting any capture (switching tabs, backing out, stopping early) never leaves a stray partial or empty Entry behind. This is the first epic to introduce `features/entries/`, which every later epic that creates or reads an Entry (Timeline, Search, Chat save-to-journal) will consume through its port — so decisions made here about that port's shape are load-bearing for the rest of the app.

## Stories

- Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell
- Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription
- Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR
- Story 3.4: Cancel-Safe Capture Across All Tabs

## Requirements & Constraints

- All three capture modalities (text, audio, photo) must produce the same persisted Entry shape; `source` is `manual`/`audio`/`photo` respectively, and each `POST /entries` call must carry the correct one.
- Audio and photo Entries are only "complete" once processed: audio via on-device transcription, photo via backend OCR. The transcribed/recognized text is editable before the user taps Salvar; the Entry is only created on explicit save, not automatically after processing finishes.
- Audio transcription runs 100% on-device via `whisper_ggml`; no call in this pipeline may ever contain audio bytes. The audio pipeline has exactly four states in sequence: recording → processing → transcribed → (on failure) error with retry; the recorded media is never discarded on a transcription failure.
- Photo OCR calls the backend before the Entry is created, mirroring the same four-state shape: capture → processing OCR → recognized → error. `OCR_NO_TEXT` is a distinct, non-retryable outcome with two recovery paths: "Tentar novamente" (retry OCR on the same photo) and "Salvar só a foto" (save with no extracted text) — never a single generic failure message. An oversized photo returns non-retryable `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413); show a size-specific message with no retry button.
- Cancel-safety (FR-11) is absolute: interrupting a capture before Salvar — closing the modal, switching Insertion Modal tabs, backing out mid-photo, stopping a recording early — must never fire `POST /entries`. Opening the modal always resets all three tabs to idle/empty; switching tabs mid-capture cancels the in-flight capture outright (resolved ambiguity — the prototype itself left this undefined).
- Offline: the "+" entry point is disabled with the same offline-banner treatment as chat send. Capture requires a live `POST /entries` round trip (PII check + embedding), so there is no local-only queued write — a write attempted with no connectivity resolves immediately to `NetworkOffline`, never queued.
- Every screen-reader-relevant state transition needs an announced label ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente," etc.) — color/animation alone never carries state.

## Technical Decisions

- Two feature modules split the work: `features/entries/` owns the `Entry` entity, the `EntriesRepository` port (`create` + `read` only — no update/delete ever), and the entries `hive_ce` box. `features/capture/` owns the Insertion Modal UI, the on-device Whisper STT flow, and the OCR call, and holds no Entry data itself — it only consumes the abstract port from `entries/domain` (never imports `entries/data/` or `entries/presentation/`). This port is exactly what RF10 (Epic 6, save chat message as entry) and RF06/RF07 (Search, Timeline) will extend/reuse later — get its shape right here, not provisionally.
- `create` on the port is idempotent on `(origin, chatMessageId)`, though that specific guard only matters starting with RF10; this epic just needs to not violate the port's shape.
- Backend calls for this epic: `POST /entries` → function `entries-create`; `POST /media/ocr` → function `media-ocr` (the photo itself is not persisted server-side, only the extracted text comes back). Both calls follow the standard header rules (`apikey` always, `Authorization: Bearer <user token>`, since neither operation is one of the three `security: []` exceptions).
- Error handling: map the 13 backend error codes (plus the local-only `MalformedResponse`) to the one sealed `Failure` hierarchy already defined in `core/failure/`. For this epic specifically: `OcrNoText` and `PayloadTooLarge` are both non-retryable and need their own distinct UI treatment, not a generic error state. The retry interceptor fires only for the 6 server `retryable:true` codes — OCR/payload failures are never auto-retried.
- The capture feature defines its own sealed state class for its multi-step audio/OCR state machines — it is explicitly excluded from using the shared generic `Resource<T>` type (`Resource<T>` is reserved for RF06/RF09's simpler single-fetch screens).
- The Insertion Modal's three tabs are internal states of one bottom sheet, never nested sheets; its entrance animation is the shared `sheetUp` (0.2s) choreography, with no other motion invented.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Insertion Modal: three equal-width tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto); only the active tab gets a filled `colorPrimary` background. A close ("x") control is always present. The modal opens on Texto by default.
- Audio tab: an animated multi-bar waveform with a monospace running timer while recording; on stop, the waveform freezes at 35% opacity with a "Transcrevendo..." label while processing (no spinner needed beyond that). Once transcribed, text is editable and "Salvar" enables; the original audio duration shows in monospace.
- Photo tab: thumbnail + spinner + "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs. Once recognized, text is editable before Salvar.
- Dynamic Type and tap-target rules (≥44pt, no truncation at largest accessibility text size) apply to all controls built here, same as everywhere else in the app.
- Reduce Motion: this epic has no cursor-blink (that's Chat), but still must honor the `sheetUp`/`scrimIn`-only animation rule and skip it when Reduce Motion is on.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Story 3.1 is the first consumer of `features/entries/` and must stand up the `Entry` entity, `EntriesRepository` port (`create`), and the entries Hive box — Stories 3.2 and 3.3 build on top of this rather than creating their own local Entry model.
- Story 3.4 (cancel-safety) is a cross-cutting rule that applies to the tab/state machines built in 3.1–3.3; it's written as its own story but has no independent UI surface — it hardens behavior already present in the other three.
- This epic depends on Epic 2 (Biometric Vault): the Insertion Modal is only reachable once the vault is unlocked.
- Everything this epic builds in `features/entries/` is a hard dependency for Epic 4 (Timeline), Epic 5 (Search), and Epic 6's RF10 (save-to-journal) — those epics extend this port rather than replacing it.

---
title: 'Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-04'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '12cdeaa93f773d1e68061196f04bb89627cdc849'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** There is no way to capture a journal Entry yet — `features/entries/` and `features/capture/` are empty scaffolds, and the Home/Chat screen has no "+" entry point.

**Approach:** Stand up `features/entries/` (Entry entity, `EntriesRepository.create` port, entries Hive box) and `features/capture/` (Insertion Modal bottom sheet with 3 tabs), and add a minimal "+" control to the Home/Chat placeholder that opens it. Only the Texto tab is functional this story.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `features/entries/domain` owns `Entry` (plain class, no freezed — mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`), `EntrySource` enum (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), and `EntriesRepository` (abstract, one method: `create`). `features/capture/` imports only `entries/domain`, never `entries/data` or `entries/presentation` (RNF06).
- `EntriesRepository.create` → `Either<Failure, Entry>`, posts to `entries-create` via the shared `ApiClient.post`, source=`manual` for this story. On success, write the entry through to the `entries` Hive box (`Box<Map>`, keyed by id) — first use of `hive_ce` in the app.
- Insertion Modal: `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners, `elevation2`, new `DesignTokens.durationSheetUp` (200ms) entrance, skipped under Reduce Motion. 3 equal-width tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto); only the active tab fills `colorPrimary`. Close "x" always present. Opens on Texto, all 3 tabs idle/empty.
- Texto tab: text field + Salvar. Salvar fires `POST /entries`; success closes the modal; failure (including offline, via the existing `Failure.networkOffline`) shows `Failure.message` inline and re-enables Salvar — no auto-retry, reuse `Failure.fromCode`/`retryable` as-is.
- "+" control on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`: always tappable, opens the modal. No proactive offline detection or banner in this story (deferred — see Spec Change Log / `deferred-work.md`); an offline save attempt surfaces the same way any other failed save does.
- 44pt tap targets, Dynamic Type with no truncation, announced labels for every state change (no color-only signal).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:**
- Implement Áudio/Foto tab capture logic (render idle/empty only — Stories 3.2/3.3).
- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story only needs the trivial case: the text tab never calls `create` except on explicit Salvar.
- Build the full chat composer (text field + send icon) — RF04's scope. Add only the "+" tap target.
- Add a connectivity service, offline banner, or any proactive offline-disabling of "+" — deferred (see `deferred-work.md`); no existing pattern to reuse, and the prototype doesn't represent this state.
- Add `GET /entries`, listing, search, or any `Entry` fields beyond `{id, content, source, chatMessageId, occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt}` (tags/piiStatus/embeddingStatus belong to later epics).
- Use the shared `Resource<T>` type for capture's state — capture defines its own sealed state class.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Happy path save | Texto tab, non-empty text, tap Salvar | `POST /entries` (`source: manual`) fires; on success modal closes, returns to Home | N/A |
| Modal open resets | "+" tapped | Opens on Texto; all 3 tabs idle/empty regardless of prior session | N/A |
| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped, backend call returns a mapped error code (e.g. `NETWORK_OFFLINE`) | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled; modal stays open | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
| Cancel before save | "x" tapped or user leaves with unsaved text | Modal closes/resets; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:76-130` (`HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`) — add the "+" entry point here; body is currently a pure placeholder (RF04 not built), no composer exists.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:85` (`colorScrimHeavy`, already reserved for "a later story's insertion modal"), `:199` (`radiusLg`), `:218` (`elevation2`) — reuse as-is; add `durationSheetUp` near these, no `Duration`/motion token exists yet.
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:67-83` (`Failure.fromCode`) — reuse unchanged; already generic, no new mapping needed.
- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart:52-62` (`post`) — call via the new `EntriesRemoteDataSource`.
- `lib/core/network/header_interceptor.dart:20-24` (`anonKeyOnlyFunctions`) — `entries-create` is not in that set, so it auto-gets the user bearer token; no changes needed.
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:26-84` (`setupCoreDependencies`) — add `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()`, after the existing `registerAccountFeature()` call.
- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart`, `account_remote_data_source.dart`, `account_settings_dto.dart`, `account_settings_repository_impl.dart`, `account_settings_cubit.dart` — structural patterns to mirror (DI registration, `ApiClient` datasource, `@JsonSerializable` DTO, repository impl, cubit calling repository directly — no use-case layer exists in this codebase).
- `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` — plain-class entity pattern (no freezed) to mirror for `Entry`.
- `lib/features/entries/{data,domain,presentation}/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/capture/{data,domain,presentation}/.gitkeep` — empty scaffolds to fill.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:327-449` — `entries-create` request/response schema.
- `pubspec.yaml:42-43` — `hive_ce`/`hive_ce_flutter` already a dependency, unused until now.
- `test/features/account/**` — test directory layout to mirror under `test/features/entries/` and `test/features/capture/`.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add `durationSheetUp = Duration(milliseconds: 200)` -- no entrance-animation token exists yet (RNF08).
- [x] `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` (new) -- `Entry` class + `EntrySource` enum -- mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`.
- [x] `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `EntriesRepository.create(...)` → `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>>` -- the port later epics extend.
- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart` (+ generated `.g.dart`) -- `@JsonSerializable()` mirroring the response `data` object.
- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` (new) -- posts to `entries-create` via `ApiClient.post`, decodes `EntryDto`.
- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- implements `create`; on success writes to the `entries` Hive box keyed by id; maps `EntryDto` → `Entry`.
- [x] `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` (new) -- registers datasource/repository, opens/registers the `entries` Hive box.
- [x] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- wire `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()`.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- own sealed state (active tab, text, saving/error); calls `EntriesRepository.create` directly on Salvar.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` (new) -- 3-tab bottom sheet; Texto functional, Áudio/Foto idle placeholders.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` (new) -- registers `TextEntryCubit`.
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- add the always-tappable "+" control to `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` that opens `InsertionModal`.
- [x] Unit/widget tests under `test/features/entries/`, `test/features/capture/` covering the I/O matrix above.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given `features/entries/` doesn't exist yet, when this story is built, then `entries/domain` owns `Entry` + `EntriesRepository(create)` + the entries Hive box, and `features/capture/` never imports `entries/data` or `entries/presentation`.
- Given the "+" control, when tapped, then the Insertion Modal opens with the `sheetUp` entrance (skipped under Reduce Motion).
- Given any state change this story introduces, when a screen reader is active, then an announced label accompanies it — never color/animation alone.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.

### Review Findings

**Patch:**
- [x] [Review][Patch] Fast double-tap after a successful save can fire a second `POST /entries` [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart:112]
- [x] [Review][Patch] "Registro salvo" announcement isn't awaited before the modal pops [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:166]

- [x] [Review][Patch] `_TabButton`'s `Semantics` label risks double-announcing the tab name [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:295]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `TextField`'s default "0/20000" character counter is unaccounted for [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:426]

**Defer:**
- [x] [Review][Defer] A local Hive write failure after a successful backend create risks a duplicate entry on retry [lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:45] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] Raw exception text is surfaced verbatim as user-facing/announced copy [lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:45] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] Hive write failure is mapped to `malformedResponse`, documented for parse failures, not local I/O [lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:45] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] An exception during `Hive.initFlutter()`/`registerEntriesFeature()` crashes app startup with no fallback [lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:90] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] `EntrySource.audio`/`EntrySource.photo` are never exercised through the datasource/Hive serialization layer [test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart] — deferred, pre-existing

## Spec Change Log

- 2026-11-04 — Token-count checkpoint (step-02): spec exceeded 1600 tokens (~2676) because it bundled a proactive offline-detection/banner pattern that doesn't exist anywhere in the app yet. Human chose [S] Split: carved the connectivity/banner work out to `deferred-work.md` and narrowed this story's "+" control to always-tappable, with offline failures surfacing through the existing reactive `Failure.networkOffline` path. - **Hive storage shape:** entries are cached as raw `Map<String, dynamic>` (via `EntryDto.toJson()`), not a generated `HiveObject`/`TypeAdapter` — avoids adapter codegen for a box nothing reads yet (reads start in Epic 4); revisit if a future story needs typed queries.

- **"+" is minimal:** a single tappable control, not the RF04 composer bar — avoids building chat-input UI that RF04 will define and may not match.

content.content:
530	### Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription
531	
532	As a user,
533	I want to record audio in the Insertion Modal and have it transcribed on-device,
534	So that I can speak my day instead of typing it, without my voice ever leaving my phone.
535	
536	**Acceptance Criteria:**
537	
538	**Given** the Áudio tab
539	**When** I start recording
540	**Then** an animated waveform (UX-DR12) shows in the structural palette with a mono counter ticking up.
541	
542	**Given** I stop recording
543	**When** `whisper_ggml` transcribes on-device
544	**Then** the waveform freezes at 35% opacity (UX-DR12) and exactly four states occur in sequence: recording → processing → transcribed → (on failure) error with retry — media is never discarded on failure.
545	
546	**Given** transcription completes
547	**When** I review the text
548	**Then** it is editable before I tap Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source=audio`.
549	
550	**Given** the audio file at any point in this pipeline
551	**When** any network call is inspected
552	**Then** no call ever contains audio bytes — transcription is 100% on-device (FR-12).
553	**And** the screen-reader announces each transition ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente") per UX-DR21.
554	
555	### Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR
556	
557	As a user,
558	I want to capture or select a photo in the Insertion Modal and have its text recognized,
559	So that I can save a physical note or receipt-like artifact without retyping it.
560	
561	**Acceptance Criteria:**
562	
563	**Given** the Foto tab
564	**When** I capture or select a photo
565	**Then** it is sent to `POST /media/ocr` to extract text before the Entry is created, mirroring the audio pipeline's four-state pattern (capture → processing OCR → recognized → error).
566	
567	**Given** OCR fails with `OCR_NO_TEXT`
568	**When** the error state shows
569	**Then** it is presented as a distinct, non-retryable outcome with two recovery paths — "Tentar novamente" (re-invokes OCR on the same photo) and "Salvar só a foto" (saves the record with no extracted text) — never a single generic failure.
570	
571	**Given** recognized text
572	**When** I review it
573	**Then** it is editable before I tap Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source=photo`.
574	
575	**Given** the photo exceeds the upload size limit
576	**When** `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413, non-retryable) is returned
577	**Then** a size-specific error message is shown with no retry button, since retrying the same oversized file cannot succeed.
578	
579	### Story 3.4: Cancel-Safe Capture Across All Tabs
580	
581	As a user,
582	I want interrupting a capture in progress to never create a partial Entry,
583	So that I never end up with junk in my journal from a capture I abandoned.
584	
585	**Acceptance Criteria:**
586	
587	**Given** a recording or OCR/transcription in progress
588	**When** I switch to a different Insertion Modal tab
589	**Then** the in-flight capture is canceled outright — no partial Entry is created (resolves PRD OQ-3).
590	
591	**Given** I back out of the modal mid-photo or stop a recording before tapping Salvar
592	**When** the modal closes
593	**Then** no `POST /entries` call fires for the abandoned capture.
594	
595	**Given** any of the three tabs
596	**When** a capture is interrupted
597	**Then** it is the Insertion Modal's own internal tab state that resets — the three tabs remain internal states of one sheet, never nested sheets (UX-DR36).
598	
599	## Epic 4: Timeline & History
600	
601	Users can see every Entry they've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological view with a live per-entry sync status — and never lose track of something they wrote, even offline or mid-session-expiry.
602	
603	### Story 4.1: Chronological Entry List with Origin Marking
604	
605	As a user,
606	I want to see every Entry I've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological list grouped by date,

### Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription

As a user,
I want to record audio in the Insertion Modal and have it transcribed on-device,
So that I can speak my day instead of typing it, without my voice ever leaving my phone.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the Áudio tab
**When** I start recording
**Then** an animated waveform (UX-DR12) shows in the structural palette with a mono counter ticking up.

**Given** I stop recording
**When** `whisper_ggml` transcribes on-device
**Then** the waveform freezes at 35% opacity (UX-DR12) and exactly four states occur in sequence: recording → processing → transcribed → (on failure) error with retry — media is never discarded on failure.

**Given** transcription completes
**When** I review the text
**Then** it is editable before I tap Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source=audio`.

**Given** the audio file at any point in this pipeline
**When** any network call is inspected
**Then** no call ever contains audio bytes — transcription is 100% on-device (FR-12).
**And** the screen-reader announces each transition ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente") per UX-DR21.

### Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR

As a user,
I want to capture or select a photo in the Insertion Modal and have its text recognized,
So that I can save a physical note or receipt-like artifact without retyping it.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the Foto tab
**When** I capture or select a photo
**Then** it is sent to `POST /media/ocr` to extract text before the Entry is created, mirroring the audio pipeline's four-state pattern (capture → processing OCR → recognized → error).

**Given** OCR fails with `OCR_NO_TEXT`
**When** the error state shows
**Then** it is presented as a distinct, non-retryable outcome with two recovery paths — "Tentar novamente" (re-invokes OCR on the same photo) and "Salvar só a foto" (saves the record with no extracted text) — never a single generic failure.

**Given** recognized text
**When** I review it
**Then** it is editable before I tap Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source=photo`.

**Given** the photo exceeds the upload size limit
**When** `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413, non-retryable) is returned
**Then** a size-specific error message is shown with no retry button, since retrying the same oversized file cannot succeed.

### Story 3.4: Cancel-Safe Capture Across All Tabs

As a user,
I want interrupting a capture in progress to never create a partial Entry,
So that I never end up with junk in my journal from a capture I abandoned.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a recording or OCR/transcription in progress
**When** I switch to a different Insertion Modal tab
**Then** the in-flight capture is canceled outright — no partial Entry is created (resolves PRD OQ-3).

**Given** I back out of the modal mid-photo or stop a recording before tapping Salvar
**When** the modal closes
**Then** no `POST /entries` call fires for the abandoned capture.

**Given** any of the three tabs
**When** a capture is interrupted
**Then** it is the Insertion Modal's own internal tab state that resets — the three tabs remain internal states of one sheet, never nested sheets (UX-DR36).

## Epic 4: Timeline & History

Users can see every Entry they've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological view with a live per-entry sync status — and never lose track of something they wrote, even offline or mid-session-expiry.

### Story 4.1: Chronological Entry List with Origin Marking

As a user,
I want to see every Entry I've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological list grouped by date,
So that I never lose track of something I wrote.

+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-3-1-text-entry-capture-insertion-modal-shell.md`
+  summary: `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create`'s Hive-write-failure catch reuses `Failure.malformedResponse`, whose own doc comment scopes it to "a 200 response that doesn't match the expected shape" (a parse failure) — not a local disk/Hive I/O failure, which is a different cause entirely.

Revisit if a future feature needs to distinguish "local persistence failed" from "server sent something we couldn't parse."

+  summary: An exception thrown by the new `Hive.initFlutter()`/`registerEntriesFeature()` calls during app bootstrap propagates out of `setupCoreDependencies()` uncaught — `main.dart`'s own `try`/`catch` around that call only logs and `rethrow`s, so the app still crashes with no fallback UI.

input.prompt:
I'm planning Story 3.2 "Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription" for a Flutter app (Cerne, a journaling app). I need a distilled investigation report (not full file dumps) covering these points. Give me file paths + line numbers + short quoted excerpts where relevant, and keep the whole report under ~600 words.

Project root: /Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b

1. **docs/input/requirements.md** — search for FR-9, FR-12, RNF (audio-related), and any mention of "whisper", "microphone", "permission", "waveform", "record", "mono", "timer", "audio file size/duration limits". Quote exact relevant lines including any acceptance criteria language not already covered by generic epic descriptions.

2. **docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md** — find the Audio/Áudio tab section: look for waveform visual spec (bar count, colors, animation), timer format, "Transcrevendo" label styling, any motion-token references (e.g. sheetUp, scrimIn), and whether a "Gravar"/record button or similar control is described. Quote the relevant section.

3. **lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart** — find the current Áudio tab placeholder implementation (likely a stub/idle widget). Give me the exact line range and content of that stub, plus how the Texto tab's functional implementation is structured (so I can see the pattern to mirror) — just enough to understand the widget structure (state listening via BlocBuilder, tab switching, Semantics/announcement usage), not the whole file.

4. **lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart** — give me the sealed state class hierarchy (class names, fields) and the shape of `selectTab`, `save`, and the close()/race-guard pattern, so I understand the convention a new audio cubit/state would need to follow. Note whether this is one cubit for all 3 tabs or dedicated per-tab.

5. **lib/core/design_tokens.dart** — list current tokens relevant to motion/duration (e.g. durationSheetUp), colors used for structural palette / waveform-adjacent colors, and confirm whether any audio/recording-specific token already exists (expect no, but check).

6. Check **pubspec.yaml** (I already confirmed `whisper_ggml: ^2.8.1` is present but no audio *recording* package like `record`/`flutter_sound`/`just_audio`). Confirm this by grep and report exactly what's there under dependencies.

7. Check whether there's any existing permission-handling package/pattern in the repo (search for "permission_handler", "Permission.", "microphone" across lib/ and pubspec.yaml) — report what you find, including nothing if nothing exists.

8. Check `docs/input/backend/` directory listing and README for anything audio-related (expect nothing, since transcription is on-device, but confirm no `/media/audio` or similar endpoint exists that I'd be missing).

9. Check the `whisper_ggml` package's pub cache or any lockfile for its public API shape if easily discoverable (e.g. `grep -r "class Whisper" ~/.pub-cache` or check `.dart_tool/package_config.json` for its resolved location, then look at its main export file) — report the key class/method names used to run local transcription (model loading, transcribe call signature, supported input format/extension). Keep this part brief — just the API surface I'd need to call it from a repository/datasource.

Report back as a structured list matching these 9 points, concise, with file:line citations. This is read-only investigation — do not write or edit anything.

12	/// from the Home/Chat "+" control (`placeholder_screens.dart`). Only
13	/// Texto is functional this story (Boundaries) — Áudio/Foto each render

15	class InsertionModal extends StatelessWidget {
16	  const InsertionModal({required this.cubit, super.key});
17	
18	  final TextEntryCubit cubit;
19	
20	  /// Presents the modal exactly as the Boundaries dictate:
21	  /// `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor:
22	  /// colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners + `elevation2` (drawn by
23	  /// this widget's own `Container`, not Material's `elevation` double —
24	  /// same convention `ConfirmationDialog`'s card already uses), and a
25	  /// `durationSheetUp` entrance that collapses to zero under Reduce
26	  /// Motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`).
27	  ///
28	  /// [cubit] is a fresh, `get_it`-factory-scoped instance — one per "+"
29	  /// tap (Boundaries: "Modal open resets"), closed here once the sheet is
30	  /// gone, regardless of how it closed (Salvar success, "x", swipe-down,
31	  /// or barrier dismiss) — the caller never has to remember to do this
32	  /// itself.
33	  static Future<void> show(
34	    BuildContext context, {
35	    required TextEntryCubit cubit,
36	  }) async {
37	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
38	    final controller =
39	        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
40	          ..duration = reduceMotion
41	              ? Duration.zero
42	              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
43	          // Boundaries only names the entrance, but Reduce Motion should
44	          // collapse the exit the same way — otherwise dismissing the
45	          // sheet would still animate for anyone who asked for no motion.
46	          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
47	    try {
48	      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
49	        context: context,
50	        isScrollControlled: true,
51	        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
52	        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
53	        elevation: 0,
54	        transitionAnimationController: controller,
55	        builder: (_) => InsertionModal(cubit: cubit),
56	      );
57	    } finally {
58	      // `showModalBottomSheet`'s own Future completes as soon as the
59	      // route is popped — *before* the exit (`reverse()`) animation the
60	      // framework drives on this same controller actually finishes.
61	      // Disposing immediately would cancel that animation's ticker
62	      // mid-flight, permanently freezing the sheet on screen (its
63	      // `AnimatedBuilder` keeps rendering the controller's last value,
64	      // and the route itself never reaches `AnimationStatus.dismissed`
65	      // to be removed from the `Overlay`). Documented behavior
66	      // (`BottomSheet.transitionAnimationController`'s own doc: "the
67	      // caller is responsible for disposing it when the controller is
68	      // no longer needed") — waiting for `dismissed` first is that
69	      // "no longer needed" point.
70	      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
71	        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
72	        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
73	          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
74	            animationDone.complete();

78	        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);

109	
110	  @override
111	  void initState() {
112	    super.initState();
113	    _lastAnnouncedTab = context.read<TextEntryCubit>().state.activeTab;
114	  }
115	
116	  @override
117	  void dispose() {
118	    _textController.dispose();
119	    super.dispose();
120	  }
121	
122	  // Labels for the 3 tabs, shared between the announcement below and
123	  // `_TabBar`'s own rendering (`_TabBar._tabs`) — kept here too since
124	  // `selectTab`'s announcement needs the label for whichever tab the
125	  // user just switched *to*, not the cubit's own (enum-only) state.
126	  static const _tabLabels = {
127	    CaptureTab.texto: 'Texto',
128	    CaptureTab.audio: 'Áudio',
129	    CaptureTab.foto: 'Foto',
130	  };
131	
132	  // Mirrors `account_settings_screen.dart`'s own `_announce` — VoiceOver
133	  // (this app is iOS-only) doesn't reliably treat a live-region subtree
134	  // update as an announcement on its own, so every state change this
135	  // story introduces — saving, success, failure, and a tab switch — is
136	  // spoken explicitly here instead (Acceptance Criteria: "no
137	  // color/animation alone").
138	  Future<void> _announce(String message) async {
139	    if (!mounted) {
140	      return;
141	    }
142	    await SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement(
143	      View.of(context),
144	      message,
145	      TextDirection.ltr,
146	    );
147	  }
148	
149	  @override
150	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
151	    return BlocConsumer<TextEntryCubit, TextEntryState>(
152	      listener: (context, state) {
153	        // Review finding: a tab switch (re-emitted as `TextEntryIdle`,
154	        // same as every keystroke) previously went unannounced —
155	        // detected here by comparing against the last tab seen, so a
156	        // plain keystroke (same `activeTab`) never re-triggers it.
157	        if (state.activeTab != _lastAnnouncedTab) {
158	          _lastAnnouncedTab = state.activeTab;
159	          _announce('Aba ${_tabLabels[state.activeTab]} selecionada');
160	        }
161	        switch (state) {
162	          case TextEntrySaved():
163	            // I/O matrix: "success closes the modal". Review finding:
164	            // wait for the announcement to actually be sent before
165	            // popping — previously fired-and-forgot in the same tick,
166	            // risking the announcement being cut off by the dismiss
167	            // transition.
168	            unawaited(
169	              _announce('Registro salvo').then((_) {
170	                if (context.mounted) {
171	                  Navigator.of(context).pop();
172	                }
173	              }),
174	            );
175	          case TextEntrySaving():
176	            _announce('Salvando registro');
177	          case TextEntryError():
178	            _announce(state.message);
179	          case TextEntryIdle():
180	            break;
181	        }
182	      },
183	      builder: (context, state) {
184	        final isSaving = state is TextEntrySaving;
185	        return Container(
186	          padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
187	          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
188	            color: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
189	            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
190	              top: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusLg),
191	            ),
192	            boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation2,
193	          ),
194	          child: Padding(
195	            // Keeps the Texto field clear of the on-screen keyboard — the
196	            // sheet is `isScrollControlled: true`, so it already grows to
197	            // fit; this is the standard companion fix for the keyboard
198	            // inset itself.
199	            padding: EdgeInsets.only(
200	              bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom,
201	            ),
202	            child: SafeArea(
203	              top: false,
204	              child: Column(
205	                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
206	                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
207	                children: [
208	                  Row(
209	                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
210	                    children: [
211	                      Expanded(
212	                        child: _TabBar(
213	                          activeTab: state.activeTab,
214	                          isSaving: isSaving,
215	                        ),
216	                      ),
217	                      const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
218	                      _CloseButton(isSaving: isSaving),
219	                    ],
220	                  ),
221	                  const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
222	                  switch (state.activeTab) {
223	                    CaptureTab.texto => _TextoTab(
224	                      controller: _textController,
225	                      state: state,
226	                    ),
227	                    CaptureTab.audio => const _IdleTabPlaceholder(
228	                      icon: Icons.mic_none,
229	                      label: 'Áudio chega em breve',
230	                    ),
231	                    CaptureTab.foto => const _IdleTabPlaceholder(
232	                      icon: Icons.photo_camera_outlined,
233	                      label: 'Foto chega em breve',
234	                    ),
235	                  },
236	                ],
237	              ),
238	            ),
239	          ),
240	        );
241	      },
242	    );
243	  }
244	}
245	
246	class _TabBar extends StatelessWidget {
247	  const _TabBar({required this.activeTab, required this.isSaving});
248	
249	  final CaptureTab activeTab;
250	
251	  /// Review finding: a save already in flight must disable the tab bar —
252	  /// without this, switching tabs mid-save let that stale `save()` call's
253	  /// eventual `TextEntrySaved`/`TextEntryError` land against a tab/text
254	  /// the user has since left (popping the modal unexpectedly, or showing
255	  /// an error nobody is looking at). `TextEntryCubit.selectTab` also
256	  /// guards against this independently — this is the UI-level half of
257	  /// that same fix.
258	  final bool isSaving;
259	
260	  static const _tabs = [
261	    (CaptureTab.texto, 'Texto'),
262	    (CaptureTab.audio, 'Áudio'),
263	    (CaptureTab.foto, 'Foto'),
264	  ];
265	
266	  @override
267	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
268	    return Row(
269	      children: [
270	        for (var i = 0; i < _tabs.length; i++) ...[
271	          Expanded(
272	            child: _TabButton(
273	              tab: _tabs[i].$1,
274	              label: _tabs[i].$2,
275	              isActive: _tabs[i].$1 == activeTab,
276	              isSaving: isSaving,
277	            ),
278	          ),
279	          if (i < _tabs.length - 1)
280	            const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
281	        ],
282	      ],
283	    );
284	  }
285	}
286	
287	class _TabButton extends StatelessWidget {
288	  const _TabButton({
289	    required this.tab,
290	    required this.label,
291	    required this.isActive,
292	    required this.isSaving,
293	  });
294	
295	  final CaptureTab tab;
296	  final String label;
297	  final bool isActive;
298	  final bool isSaving;
299	
300	  @override
301	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
302	    return Semantics(
303	      button: true,
304	      selected: isActive,
305	      label: 'Aba $label',
306	      // Review finding: without this, VoiceOver can also pick up the
307	      // inner `Text(label)`'s own implicit semantics as a separate node,
308	      // announcing the tab name twice back-to-back.
309	      excludeSemantics: true,
310	      child: Material(
311	        color: isActive ? DesignTokens.colorPrimary : Colors.transparent,
312	        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
313	          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
314	        ),
315	        child: InkWell(
316	          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
317	            Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
318	          ),
319	          // Review finding: `null` while a save is in flight, same
320	          // "disabled `onTap` can never start a second, overlapping call"
321	          // convention `account_settings_screen.dart`'s `Switch` already
322	          // uses.
323	          onTap: isSaving
324	              ? null
325	              : () => context.read<TextEntryCubit>().selectTab(tab),
326	          child: Container(
327	            constraints: const BoxConstraints(
328	              minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
329	            ),
330	            alignment: Alignment.center,
331	            padding: DesignTokens.buttonPadding,
332	            child: Text(
333	              label,
334	              style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd.copyWith(
335	                color: isActive
336	                    ? DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary
337	                    : DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
338	              ),
339	            ),
340	          ),
341	        ),
342	      ),
343	    );
344	  }
345	}
346	
347	class _CloseButton extends StatelessWidget {
348	  const _CloseButton({required this.isSaving});
349	
350	  /// Review finding — same rationale as `_TabBar.isSaving`: disabled
351	  /// while a save is in flight, so "x" can't pop the modal out from under
352	  /// a `save()` call that's about to emit `TextEntrySaved`/`TextEntryError`
353	  /// against the tab/text it captured at call time. (Swipe-down/barrier
354	  /// dismiss can still close the sheet mid-save — that gap is tracked
355	  /// separately in `deferred-work.md`, not part of this fix.)
356	  final bool isSaving;
357	
358	  @override
359	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
360	    return Semantics(
361	      button: true,
362	      label: 'Fechar',
363	      child: InkWell(
364	        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
365	          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
366	        ),
367	        // I/O matrix: "Cancel before save" — closes/resets, never calls
368	        // `create` (this handler never touches the cubit at all).
369	        onTap: isSaving ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
370	        child: SizedBox(
371	          width: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
372	          height: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
373	          child: Icon(
374	            Icons.close,
375	            color: isSaving
376	                ? DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary
377	                : DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
378	          ),
379	        ),
380	      ),
381	    );
382	  }
383	}
384	
385	class _IdleTabPlaceholder extends StatelessWidget {
386	  const _IdleTabPlaceholder({required this.icon, required this.label});
387	
388	  final IconData icon;
389	  final String label;
390	
391	  @override
392	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
393	    return Padding(
394	      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: DesignTokens.spacingXl),
395	      child: Column(
396	        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
397	        children: [
398	          Icon(
399	            icon,
400	            size: DesignTokens.spacing2xl,
401	            color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
402	          ),
403	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
404	          Text(
405	            label,
406	            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
407	            style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
408	              color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
409	            ),
410	          ),
411	        ],
412	      ),
413	    );
414	  }
415	}
416	
417	class _TextoTab extends StatelessWidget {
418	  const _TextoTab({required this.controller, required this.state});
419	
420	  final TextEditingController controller;
421	  final TextEntryState state;
422	
423	  @override
424	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
425	    final isSaving = state is TextEntrySaving;
426	    // Review finding: also false while TextEntrySaved — the sheet is
427	    // about to pop (same rationale as TextEntryCubit.save()'s own guard),
428	    // so Salvar shouldn't be tappable during that brief window either.
429	    final canSave =
430	        controller.text.trim().isNotEmpty && !isSaving && state is! TextEntrySaved;
431	    return Column(
432	      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
433	      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
434	      children: [
435	        TextField(
436	          controller: controller,
437	          enabled: !isSaving,
438	          minLines: 3,
439	          maxLines: null,
440	          // Mirrors `POST /entries`'s own `content` cap
441	          // (`openapi.yaml`: `maxLength: 20000`) — avoids an avoidable
442	          // round-trip failure for text typed past the backend's limit.
443	          maxLength: 20000,
444	          onChanged: (value) =>
445	              context.read<TextEntryCubit>().updateText(value),
446	          style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(
447	            color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
448	          ),
449	          decoration: InputDecoration(
450	            // prototype-extract.md §2.3's Texto state: placeholder
451	            // "Escreva livremente...".
452	            hintText: 'Escreva livremente...',
453	            // Review finding: suppresses Material's default "0/20000"
454	            // counter — the prototype's Texto state shows no such
455	            // element, and nothing here accounts for its styling.
456	            counterText: '',
457	            contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
458	            border: const OutlineInputBorder(
459	              borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
460	                Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
461	              ),
462	              borderSide: BorderSide(
463	                color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
464	                width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault,
465	              ),
466	            ),
467	            focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
468	              borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
469	                Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
470	              ),
471	              borderSide: BorderSide(
472	                color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
473	                width: DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis,
474	              ),
475	            ),
476	          ),
477	        ),
478	        if (state is TextEntryError) ...[
479	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
480	          Text(
481	            (state as TextEntryError).message,
482	            style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
483	              color: DesignTokens.colorError,
484	            ),
485	          ),
486	        ],
487	        const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
488	        AppButton(
489	          label: isSaving ? 'Salvando...' : 'Salvar',
490	          onPressed: canSave
491	              ? () => context.read<TextEntryCubit>().save()
492	              : null,
493	        ),
494	      ],
495	    );
496	  }
497	}

1	/// `POST /entries`'s four possible origins (`openapi.yaml:345-351`). This
2	/// story only ever produces [manual] (Boundaries: "source=manual for this
3	/// story") — the other three exist here already so the port
4	/// ([EntriesRepository.create]) doesn't need to change shape when Stories
5	/// 3.2/3.3 (audio/photo) and RF10 (chat) start passing them.
6	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }
7	
8	/// A saved journal entry — plain `{id, content, source, chatMessageId,
9	/// occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt}` class, no `freezed`
10	/// (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`: this feature has no need for the
11	/// union/copyWith machinery `Failure` uses). Boundaries: never a field
12	/// beyond this exact set — `tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/`embeddingStatus`/
13	/// `mediaDurationSeconds` belong to later epics, not this story.
14	///
15	/// [occurredAt]/[createdAt]/[updatedAt] are kept as the backend's own ISO
16	/// 8601 strings rather than parsed into `DateTime` — nothing in this story
17	/// reads or formats them (Design Notes: the Hive box nothing reads from
18	/// yet), so parsing would add risk (a malformed string throwing) with no
19	/// behavior to justify it.
20	class Entry {
21	  const Entry({
22	    required this.id,
23	    required this.content,
24	    required this.source,
25	    required this.chatMessageId,
26	    required this.occurredAt,
27	    required this.serverRevision,
28	    required this.createdAt,
29	    required this.updatedAt,
30	  });
31	
32	  final String id;
33	  final String content;
34	  final EntrySource source;
35	
36	  /// Non-null only for a [EntrySource.chat]-sourced entry (RF10) — always
37	  /// `null` for this story's [EntrySource.manual] entries.
38	  final String? chatMessageId;
39	  final String occurredAt;
40	  final int serverRevision;
41	  final String createdAt;
42	  final String updatedAt;
43	
44	  @override
45	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
46	      identical(this, other) ||
47	      (other is Entry &&
48	          other.id == id &&
49	          other.content == content &&
50	          other.source == source &&
51	          other.chatMessageId == chatMessageId &&
52	          other.occurredAt == occurredAt &&
53	          other.serverRevision == serverRevision &&
54	          other.createdAt == createdAt &&
55	          other.updatedAt == updatedAt);
56	
57	  @override
58	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
59	    id,
60	    content,
61	    source,
62	    chatMessageId,
63	    occurredAt,
64	    serverRevision,
65	    createdAt,
66	    updatedAt,
67	  );
68	
69	  @override

---
title: 'Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-04'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '8e92fd7273e4e66736635cb77d2ffc44d58a88e5'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The Áudio tab is still an idle placeholder (`_IdleTabPlaceholder`) — recording, on-device transcription, and saving a `source=audio` Entry don't exist, and the app has no audio-recording package or microphone-permission handling at all.

**Approach:** Add a new `AudioEntryCubit` (its own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`) driving the 4-state pipeline — recording → processing → transcribed → error — backed by two new `capture/domain` ports: `MicRecorder` (`record` package) and `AudioTranscriber` (`whisper_ggml`). Extend `Entry`/`EntriesRepository.create` with the optional `mediaDurationSeconds` field the backend contract already reserves. Wire tab switching into/out of Áudio to start/stop the recorder.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Add `record: ^6.0.0` to `pubspec.yaml` for mic capture (`AudioEncoder.wav`, amplitude stream, built-in permission request via `hasPermission()` — no separate `permission_handler` dependency). `capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart` defines abstract `MicRecorder` (start/stop→`(path, duration)`/cancel/amplitude stream); `capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart` implements it, wrapping `package:record`'s `AudioRecorder` behind an aliased import (name clash with our own port).
- `capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` defines `abstract class AudioTranscriber { Future<String?> transcribe(String audioPath); }` — `null` means transcription failed; this is a local-only outcome, never a `Failure` (RNF09 scopes `Failure` to repository/backend calls). `capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` implements it: `WhisperController().downloadModel(WhisperModel.base)` (idempotent) then `.transcribe(audioPath, lang: 'pt')`, catching any exception into `null`.
- `AudioEntryCubit` (new): sealed `AudioCaptureState` — `AudioIdle` (pre-recording) → `AudioRecording(elapsed)` → `AudioProcessing(path, duration)` → `AudioTranscribed(path, duration, text, saving)` → `AudioError(path, duration, message)`. `startRecording()`/`cancel()` are called from `InsertionModal`'s existing tab-switch listener; stop auto-transitions Recording→Processing→Transcribed/Error. The recorded file is never deleted on transcription failure; "Tentar novamente" re-runs `AudioTranscriber.transcribe` on the same path.
- `EntriesRepository.create`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource.create`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl.create`/`Entry`/`EntryDto` all gain an optional `int? mediaDurationSeconds` (sent/decoded only when non-null) — already reserved in `openapi.yaml`'s entries-create request+response. `AudioEntryCubit.save()` calls `create(content: editedText, source: EntrySource.audio, mediaDurationSeconds: duration.inSeconds)`, mirroring `TextEntryCubit.save()`'s race guards (`isClosed`, no double-submit).
- Mic-permission denial surfaces as `AudioError` with a permission-specific message; its "Tentar novamente" re-requests permission (no file exists yet). Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement ("Gravando"/"Transcrevendo"/"Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente") via the existing `_announce` helper.
- `InsertionModal` adds a second `BlocProvider`/`BlocListener` for `AudioEntryCubit` alongside the existing `TextEntryCubit` one (`MultiBlocProvider`/`MultiBlocListener`); `show()`'s `finally` closes both cubits. `capture_injection.dart` registers `AudioEntryCubit` as a factory.

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:**
- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story only needs the trivial case: `AudioEntryCubit.save()` never fires `create` except on explicit Salvar, and leaving the Áudio tab mid-recording stops the recorder (resource safety) without the full "cancels outright" choreography 3.4 hardens.
- Send audio bytes to the backend in any call — transcription is 100% on-device (FR-12); only the resulting text ever reaches `entries-create`.
- Build Story 3.3's Foto tab or touch its placeholder.
- Add `permission_handler` or any separate permission package — `record`'s own `hasPermission()` is sufficient.
- Write an automated test exercising the real `record`/`whisper_ggml` native plugins (no device/simulator exists, AGENTS.md) — `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber` are mocked (mocktail) in `AudioEntryCubit` tests, same convention as `EntriesRepository` in `TextEntryCubit` tests.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Happy path | Switch to Áudio, record, stop, review text, tap Salvar | Waveform animates while recording; freezes at 35% opacity while transcribing; text editable once transcribed; `POST /entries` (`source: audio`, `mediaDurationSeconds`) fires; success closes modal | N/A |
| Transcription fails | `AudioTranscriber.transcribe` returns `null` | `AudioError` shown, audio file preserved, "Tentar novamente" re-transcribes the same file | No auto-retry |
| Mic permission denied | `MicRecorder.start()` permission check fails | `AudioError` with permission-specific message; "Tentar novamente" re-requests permission | No file to preserve |
| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped from `AudioTranscribed`, `create` returns a `Failure` | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled, text/audio preserved | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
| Leave tab mid-recording | Switch to Texto/Foto while `AudioRecording`/`AudioProcessing` | Recorder stopped/released; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `pubspec.yaml:52` -- add `record: ^6.0.0` beneath `whisper_ggml` -- only new runtime dependency (permission handling comes free with it).
- `lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- abstract `MicRecorder` port -- mirrors `EntriesRepository`'s abstract-port convention.
- `lib/features/capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- abstract `AudioTranscriber` port.
- `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- wraps `package:record`'s `AudioRecorder`, writes a temp-dir `.wav` (`path_provider`'s `getTemporaryDirectory()`, already transitive via `hive_ce_flutter`).
- `lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- wraps `whisper_ggml`'s `WhisperController` (`downloadModel`+`transcribe`, `lang: 'pt'`, `WhisperModel.base`).
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `AudioEntryCubit` + sealed `AudioCaptureState`.
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:13-16` -- register `AudioEntryCubit`, `MicRecorder`, `AudioTranscriber`.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:33-91` (`show`/`build`) -- accept a second `audioCubit`, `MultiBlocProvider`, close both in `show()`'s `finally`.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:150-182` (`_InsertionModalBodyState.build` listener) -- extend tab-switch detection to call `AudioEntryCubit.startRecording()`/`.cancel()`; add a listener for Audio's Saved→announce→pop path.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:222-235` (`switch (state.activeTab)`) -- replace the `CaptureTab.audio` placeholder branch with a new `_AudioTab` widget (mirrors `_TextoTab:417-497`).
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96` -- resolve `sl<AudioEntryCubit>()` too, pass to `InsertionModal.show`.
- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` -- add nullable `mediaDurationSeconds` (9th field), update `==`/`hashCode`/`toString`.
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart:17-20` -- add optional `int? mediaDurationSeconds` param.
- `lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart` (+ regenerated `.g.dart`) -- add nullable `mediaDurationSeconds`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart:20-27` -- include it in the request body only when non-null.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:30-60` -- thread the param through, add to `_toEntry`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:345-358,439` -- `mediaDurationSeconds` request/response field (already optional, `minimum: 0`).
- `docs/input/backend/fixtures/README.md`/`expected-transcription.md`/`media/audio_fixture_01.wav` -- manual-verification fixture only (no device to run real whisper in automated tests).
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:51` (`colorError`) -- reuse for the Gravando stop-button/waveform accent (prototype: "Red stop button"); `:158` (`textMonoCaption`) -- reuse for timer/duration labels; no new token needed.
- `test/features/capture/**`, `test/features/entries/**` -- mirror 3.1's layout for the new cubit/services/port-extension tests.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `pubspec.yaml` -- add `record: ^6.0.0` -- new mic-capture dependency.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- abstract `MicRecorder` port.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- abstract `AudioTranscriber` port.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- `record`-backed implementation.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- `whisper_ggml`-backed implementation.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `AudioEntryCubit` + `AudioCaptureState` hierarchy.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` -- register `AudioEntryCubit`/`MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`.
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`, `entries_repository.dart`, `entry_dto.dart` (+ generated), `entries_remote_data_source.dart`, `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- add `mediaDurationSeconds`.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` -- wire second cubit, tab-switch start/cancel, new `_AudioTab` widget, Saved→pop listener.
- [ ] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- resolve and pass `AudioEntryCubit`.
- [ ] Unit/widget tests under `test/features/capture/`, `test/features/entries/` covering the I/O matrix above.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Áudio tab, when I switch into it, then recording starts immediately with an animated waveform and monospace running timer.
- Given recording stops, when `whisper_ggml` transcribes on-device, then the waveform freezes at 35% opacity during processing and no network call in this pipeline ever carries audio bytes.
- Given transcription completes, when I review the text, then it is editable before Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source: audio` and `mediaDurationSeconds`.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- **Two cubits, one modal:** `TextEntryCubit` stays the modal's `activeTab` source of truth (existing); `AudioEntryCubit` only owns the audio pipeline. `InsertionModal`'s existing tab-switch listener is the single bridge between them — avoids rearchitecting `TextEntryCubit` or merging unrelated state shapes.
- **`WhisperModel.base`, `lang: 'pt'`:** balances accuracy/size for Portuguese on-device transcription; swappable later without a port-shape change.
- **Model download is lazy, inside `transcribe()`:** no separate first-run step; a missing model + no connectivity surfaces through the same generic `AudioError`/retry path as any other transcription failure.
- **`mediaDurationSeconds` lands now, not "later":** `entry.dart`'s own Story 3.1 comment already named it as deferred to "later epics" — this is that later story.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves `record` with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- regenerates `entry_dto.g.dart` with the new field.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- On a real device/simulator (none exists yet, AGENTS.md): record a short Portuguese phrase, confirm it transcribes and an `audio`-sourced Entry saves; optionally compare against `docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav` + `expected-transcription.md` for rough transcription-quality sanity, not exact match.

- `capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` defines `abstract class AudioTranscriber { Future<String?> transcribe(String audioPath); }` — `null` means transcription failed; this is a local-only outcome, never a `Failure` (RNF09 scopes `Failure` to repository/backend calls). `capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` implements it: `WhisperController().downloadModel(WhisperModel.base)` (idempotent) then `.transcribe(audioPath, lang: 'pt')`, catching any exception into `null`.
- `AudioEntryCubit` (new): sealed `AudioCaptureState` — `AudioIdle` (pre-recording) → `AudioRecording(elapsed)` → `AudioProcessing(path, duration)` → `AudioTranscribed(path, duration, text, saving)` → `AudioError(path, duration, message)`. `startRecording()`/`cancel()` are called from `InsertionModal`'s existing tab-switch listener; stop auto-transitions Recording→Processing→Transcribed/Error. The recorded file is never deleted on transcription failure; "Tentar novamente" re-runs `AudioTranscriber.transcribe` on the same path.
- `EntriesRepository.create`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource.create`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl.create`/`Entry`/`EntryDto` all gain an optional `int? mediaDurationSeconds` (sent/decoded only when non-null) — already reserved in `openapi.yaml`'s entries-create request+response. `AudioEntryCubit.save()` calls `create(content: editedText, source: EntrySource.audio, mediaDurationSeconds: duration.inSeconds)`, mirroring `TextEntryCubit.save()`'s race guards (`isClosed`, no double-submit).
- Mic-permission denial surfaces as `AudioError` with a permission-specific message; its "Tentar novamente" re-requests permission (no file exists yet). Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement ("Gravando"/"Transcrevendo"/"Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente") via the existing `_announce` helper.

- Send audio bytes to the backend in any call — transcription is 100% on-device (FR-12); only the resulting text ever reaches `entries-create`.
- Build Story 3.3's Foto tab or touch its placeholder.

input.old_string:
## Design Notes

- **Two cubits, one modal:** `TextEntryCubit` stays the modal's `activeTab` source of truth (existing); `AudioEntryCubit` only owns the audio pipeline. `InsertionModal`'s existing tab-switch listener is the single bridge between them — avoids rearchitecting `TextEntryCubit` or merging unrelated state shapes.
- **`WhisperModel.base`, `lang: 'pt'`:** balances accuracy/size for Portuguese on-device transcription; swappable later without a port-shape change.
- **Model download is lazy, inside `transcribe()`:** no separate first-run step; a missing model + no connectivity surfaces through the same generic `AudioError`/retry path as any other transcription failure.
- **`mediaDurationSeconds` lands now, not "later":** `entry.dart`'s own Story 3.1 comment already named it as deferred to "later epics" — this is that later story.

## Summary: Story 3.2 spec drafted

**Spec:** `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-3-2-audio-entry-capture-on-device-transcription.md`

**Approach:** New `AudioEntryCubit` (own sealed state) drives a 4-state pipeline — recording → processing → transcribed → error — backed by two new `capture/domain` ports: `MicRecorder` (new `record` package dependency) and `AudioTranscriber` (wraps `whisper_ggml`). `Entry`/`EntriesRepository.create` gain the optional `mediaDurationSeconds` field the backend contract already reserves. Tab-switch into/out of Áudio starts/stops the recorder.

**Scope decisions baked in:**
- No mic-permission package needed — `record`'s own `hasPermission()` covers it.
- Permission denial and transcription failure both land on the same `AudioError` terminal state with different messages/retry semantics; audio is never deleted on failure.

Shared sub-step for updating `sprint-status.yaml` during build. Called from any route (plan-code-review, one-shot, future routes) with a `target_status` parameter.

## Preconditions

Skip this entire file (return to caller) if ANY of:
- `story_key` is unset
- `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` does not exist on disk

## Instructions

1. Load the FULL `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` file.
2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.
3. **Idempotency check.** If `development_status[{story_key}]` is already at `target_status` or a later state (`review` is later than `in-progress`; `done` is later than both), return to caller — no write needed. Never regress a story's status.
4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). 7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

  **New capture-feature files:**
  - `lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart` — `MicRecorder` port + `MicRecording` value type (plain Dart, no `package:record` type crosses this boundary).
  - `lib/features/capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` — `AudioTranscriber` port (`transcribe()` → `String?`, null = failure, never wrapped in `Failure`).
  - `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart` — wraps `package:record`'s `AudioRecorder` (16kHz mono wav, matches whisper's expected input), tracks start time itself since `stop()` only returns a path.
  - `lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` — wraps `whisper_ggml`'s `WhisperController` (`WhisperModel.base`, `lang: 'pt'`, lazy `downloadModel`), catches any exception into `null`.
  - `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart` — `AudioEntryCubit` + sealed `AudioCaptureState` (`AudioIdle`/`AudioRecording`/`AudioProcessing`/`AudioTranscribed`/`AudioSaved`/`AudioError`), covering the full recording→processing→transcribed/error pipeline, retry semantics (re-request permission vs. re-transcribe vs. re-enable Salvar), cancel-on-tab-leave, and `save()` mirroring `TextEntryCubit`'s isClosed/no-double-submit guards.
  
  **Entries feature** (`Entry`, `EntriesRepository.create`, `EntryDto` + generated `.g.dart`, `EntriesRemoteDataSource`, `EntriesRepositoryImpl`) all gained optional `int? mediaDurationSeconds`, sent/decoded only when non-null (`@JsonKey(includeIfNull: false)`), threaded end-to-end into the real Hive write-through.
  
  **Wiring:** `pubspec.yaml` (+`record: ^6.0.0`, +`path_provider` promoted to a direct dependency since it's now imported directly), `capture_injection.dart` (registers `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber` + the raw `AudioRecorder`/`WhisperController` plugin instances as lazy singletons, `AudioEntryCubit` as a factory like `TextEntryCubit`), `placeholder_screens.dart` (resolves and passes `AudioEntryCubit` to `InsertionModal.show`), `ios/Runner/Info.plist` (+`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, required by `record` on a real device).
  
  **`insertion_modal.dart`** rewritten: `MultiBlocProvider` for both cubits, tab-switch listener now starts/cancels recording on Áudio enter/leave, a new `_AudioTab` (waveform via a rolling-amplitude-sample bar visualizer, mm:ss timer, stop control, editable transcribed-text field, error/retry views) replacing the old idle placeholder, and an `AudioSaved`→announce→pop listener mirroring `TextEntrySaved`'s.
  
  ## Verification
  - `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved `record` cleanly (6 new transitive platform packages), no conflicts.
  - `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` — regenerated `entry_dto.g.dart` with the new field.
  - `fvm flutter analyze` — **zero issues**.
  - `fvm flutter test` — **448/448 passing** (up from 404 baseline), including:
    - `test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit_test.dart` (24 tests, mocktail-mocked `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`/`EntriesRepository`).
    - `test/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder_test.dart` + `whisper_audio_transcriber_test.dart` — mock the `record`/`whisper_ggml` plugin classes directly (same convention `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` uses for `LocalAuthentication`), never exercising real native plugins.
    - `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_audio_test.dart` (new, 6 end-to-end widget tests against the real `InsertionModal`/`AudioEntryCubit`).
    - Entries-feature tests extended for `mediaDurationSeconds` (datasource send/decode, repository threading, real-Hive round-trip + null-omission).
    - One pre-existing test updated (`insertion_modal_test.dart`'s "tapping Áudio switches to its own idle placeholder" → now asserts the real functional pipeline, since Áudio is no longer a placeholder).
  
  Also updated the spec's own frontmatter (`status: 'review'`) and its Tasks checklist (all boxes checked), plus `sprint-status.yaml`'s `3-2-...: review` entry, matching the project's documented dev→review workflow — left `deferred-work.md` untouched since that file's own convention is populated by a code-review pass, not the implementer.
  
  ## Notable risk/design decisions worth a reviewer's eye
  1. **Widget-test infrastructure gotcha (now worked around, not a product bug):** calling `Cubit.close()` a second time on an already-closed `Cubit` that was wired through `BlocProvider`/widget listeners hangs indefinitely under `flutter_test` (confirmed empirically). `insertion_modal_audio_test.dart`'s `tearDown` now guards with `isClosed` checks. Separately, `AudioEntryCubit`'s 1-second `Timer.periodic` (the elapsed-time ticker) must never be left running across a `pumpAndSettle()` call or a test's own end — any widget test that leaves `AudioRecording` active must explicitly `pump()` (never `pumpAndSettle()`) and/or call `cancel()`/`close()` before the test body returns, since the framework's pending-timer invariant check runs ahead of `tearDown`. Documented inline in the test file.
  2. **Waveform visualization** has no prototype mock to match (audio capture didn't exist in `cerne-prototype.html`) — I built a simple 24-bar amplitude visualizer reusing only existing design tokens (no new RNF08 literals beyond the `0.35` opacity figure, which is itself specified by the frozen Acceptance Criteria). This is a reasonable "decide and proceed" call per AGENTS.md policy, but is the one area most likely to get revised against an actual device/designer eyeball.
  3. **Orphaned temp file on tab-leave mid-processing:** when a user switches away from Áudio while transcription is still running, the cubit resets to `AudioIdle` without deleting the already-stopped recording's temp `.wav` file (only the "leave mid-*recording*" case calls `MicRecorder.cancel()`, which does delete).   Relevant files (all under `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/`):
  - `lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart`, `audio_transcriber.dart`
  - `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart`, `whisper_audio_transcriber.dart`
  - `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart`
  - `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`
  - `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart`
  - `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`, `domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`, `data/models/entry_dto.dart`, `data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart`, `data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart`
  - `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`, `ios/Runner/Info.plist`, `pubspec.yaml`
  - `test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit_test.dart`, `test/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder_test.dart`, `whisper_audio_transcriber_test.dart`, `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_audio_test.dart`

- **`WhisperModel.base`, `lang: 'pt'`, lazy download inside `transcribe()`:** balances accuracy/size; a missing model + no connectivity just surfaces through the same generic error/retry path as any other transcription failure — no new state needed.
- **`mediaDurationSeconds` lands now, not "later":** `entry.dart`'s own Story 3.1 comment named it as deferred to "later epics" — this is that story.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves `record` with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- regenerates `entry_dto.g.dart` with the new field.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- On a real device/simulator (none exists yet, AGENTS.md): record a short Portuguese phrase, confirm it transcribes and an `audio`-sourced Entry saves; optionally compare against `docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav` + `expected-transcription.md` for rough transcription-quality sanity, not exact match.
